results.name: Chest Out Hands Behind (Hold)
instructions: Begin by standing with your feet shoulder-width apart, keeping your back straight and shoulders relaxed.
Interlace your fingers behind your back, extending your arms straight.
Lift your arms slightly while pushing your chest out and squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Hold this position for the desired duration, maintaining a steady and controlled breath throughout the stretch.
tips: Focus on squeezing your shoulder blades together to deepen the stretch in your chest and shoulders.
Keep your neck relaxed and in a neutral position to avoid tension.
Use a mirror to check your form and ensure you are maintaining proper alignment.
results.description: Chest Out Hands Behind (Hold) is a beginner single-joint isolation static exercise targeting the pectorals (chest). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the flexibility category. Secondary muscles: Upper Back.

results.name: Chest Stretch With Exercise Ball
instructions: Begin on all fours, with your knees directly under your hips and your hands directly under your shoulders.
Place your right forearm on an exercise ball positioned to your side, with your elbow bent at a 90-degree angle.
Slowly lower your chest towards the floor to deepen the stretch in your chest.
Hold this position for the desired duration, then return to the starting position and switch arms to repeat the stretch on the other side.
tips: Allow your chest to lower gently towards the floor, but do not force it. Only go as far as is comfortable to avoid straining your shoulder.
Perform the movement slowly and with control to maximize the effectiveness of the stretch.
Focus on relaxing your chest and shoulder to deepen the stretch.
Ensure your hips remain aligned with your knees to maintain a stable base.
Use a mirror or partner to check your form and ensure you are maintaining proper alignment.
results.description: Chest Stretch With Exercise Ball is a beginner single-joint isolation static exercise targeting the pectorals (chest). Performed with a stability ball, it falls under the flexibility category. Secondary muscles: Shoulders, Upper Back.

results.name: Child Pose Lower Back Stretch
instructions: Kneel on the floor with your big toes together and knees apart.
Sit your hips back toward your heels.
Reach your arms forward and lower your chest toward the floor.
Rest your forehead down and breathe deeply into your lower back.
tips: Keep your knees closer together for a deeper back stretch.
Relax your shoulders.
results.description: Child Pose Lower Back Stretch is a beginner single-joint isolation static exercise targeting the spine (back). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the flexibility category. Secondary muscles: Lats, Glutes.

results.name: Circles Knee Stretch
instructions: Begin by standing with your feet together and knees slightly bent. Place your hands on your hips for support.
Keeping your knees together, bend them together and slowly rotate them in a circular motion to the right, making small controlled circles.
Continue circling your knees for the desired number of repetitions, then reverse the direction of the circles and rotate to the left.
Maintain a steady pace and keep your upper body relaxed throughout the exercise.
tips: Focus on making smooth and controlled movements to avoid straining your knees and joints.
Perform the movement slowly to maintain control and improve knee mobility.
Ensure your knees remain close together to maximize the effectiveness of the stretch.
results.description: Circles Knee Stretch is a beginner single-joint isolation static exercise targeting the quads (upper legs). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the flexibility category. Secondary muscles: Calves, Hip Flexors.

results.name: Cobra Stretch
instructions: Lie face down with your legs extended and the tops of your feet resting on the floor. Place your hands beneath your shoulders with your elbows close to your body.
Press through your hands to slowly lift your chest while extending your arms and keeping your hips in contact with the floor.
Raise your chest until you feel a comfortable stretch through your lower back and abdomen while keeping your shoulders relaxed.
Hold the stretch briefly, then slowly lower your chest back to the starting position with control.
tips: Keep your hips and legs in contact with the floor throughout the stretch.
Press up gradually and avoid forcing your lower back into excessive extension.
Keep your elbows close to your body as you lift your chest.
Exhale as you lift your chest and inhale as you lower back down.
results.description: Cobra Stretch is a beginner single-joint isolation static exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the flexibility category. Secondary muscles: Chest, Shoulders, Lower Back.

results.name: Cocoons
instructions: Begin by lying flat on your back with your legs extended straight and your arms extended overhead on the floor.
Engage your core and simultaneously lift your legs off the floor while bringing your arms forward to meet your knees, curling your body into a "cocoon" position.
Hold the cocoon position for a moment, squeezing your core muscles.
Slowly lower your legs and arms back to the starting position, maintaining control. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
tips: Focus on using your abdominal muscles to lift your legs and upper body, avoiding momentum.
Use a mat or soft surface to support your back and prevent discomfort during the exercise.
Ensure your lower back remains in contact with the floor as you lift and lower your legs to avoid unnecessary strain.
Breathe steadily throughout the exercise, exhaling as you curl into the cocoon position and inhaling as you return to the starting position.
results.description: Cocoons is a beginner single-joint isolation static exercise targeting the abs (waist). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the flexibility category. Secondary muscles: Hip Flexors, Obliques.

results.name: Corner Wall Chest Stretch
instructions: Begin by standing in front of a corner of a wall with your feet shoulder-width apart. Place your palms flat against the walls at your sides, with your elbows slightly below shoulder height.
Lean forward into the corner, keeping your legs in place, to lean into the stretch.
Push your chest forward towards the corner, feeling the stretch across your chest and shoulders. Hold this position for the desired duration.
Slowly step back to return to the starting position and repeat the stretch as needed.
tips: Perform the stretch with control, gradually increasing the intensity as your muscles loosen.
Breathe deeply and steadily throughout the stretch, inhaling as you prepare and exhaling as you lean into the stretch.
Ensure your palms remain flat against the wall to maximize the stretch across your chest and shoulders.
Use a mat or soft surface for your feet if needed to prevent slipping during the stretch.
results.description: Corner Wall Chest Stretch is a beginner single-joint isolation static exercise targeting the pectorals (chest). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the flexibility category. Secondary muscles: Shoulders, Upper Back, Biceps.

results.name: Crescent Moon Pose Quad Stretch With Block
instructions: Begin by standing beside a yoga block and move into a lunge position with one foot forward and your back knee resting on the floor.
Keeping your torso upright, grasp your back leg by the ankle and place your hand nearest to the block on top of it for support.
Gently shift your hips forward until you feel a stretch along the front of your back thigh. Hold the stretch while keeping your hips facing forward
Return to the starting position with control and repeat on the opposite side.
tips: Keep your front knee directly above your ankle.
Stretch only until you feel a comfortable pull in the front of your back thigh.
Maintain an upright torso throughout the stretch, using the yoga block as support for stability.
Inhale before moving forward and exhale as you deepen the stretch.
results.description: Crescent Moon Pose Quad Stretch With Block is a beginner single-joint isolation static exercise targeting the quads (upper legs). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the flexibility category. Secondary muscles: Hip Flexors, Glutes, Core.

results.name: Crescent Moon Pose Quad Stretch
instructions: Begin in a lunge position with one foot forward and your back knee resting on the floor. Bend your back knee and reach behind you to grasp your back foot with both hands.
Gently draw your back heel toward your glutes while keeping your chest lifted and your hips facing forward.
Hold the stretch until you feel a comfortable stretch along the front of your back thigh and hip.
Release your foot with control, return to the starting position, and repeat on the opposite side.
tips: Keep your front knee directly above your ankle.
Engage your core to help maintain balance and alignment.
Keep your chest lifted and avoid leaning excessively forward.
Inhale before deepening the stretch and exhale as you gently pull your foot closer.
results.description: Crescent Moon Pose Quad Stretch is a beginner single-joint isolation static exercise targeting the quads (upper legs). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the flexibility category. Secondary muscles: Hip Flexors, Glutes, Core.

results.name: Cross Body Elbow Pull Shoulder Stretch
instructions: Stand upright with your feet shoulder width apart and your arms relaxed by your sides. Bend one arm behind your lower back with your elbow pointing outward.
Reach across your body with your opposite hand and grasp the elbow of your bent arm.
Gently pull the elbow across your body until you feel a comfortable stretch in the your shoulder.
Hold the stretch, then slowly release and repeat on the opposite side.
tips: Pull your elbow gently without forcing it beyond a comfortable range.
Maintain a slow, steady pull rather than using quick movements.
Keep your neck relaxed and your shoulders away from your ears.
Inhale before applying the stretch and exhale as you gently deepen it.
results.description: Cross Body Elbow Pull Shoulder Stretch is a beginner single-joint isolation static exercise targeting the delts (shoulders). Performed with bodyweight, it falls under the flexibility category. Secondary muscles: Rotator Cuff, Upper Back, Chest.
